candidates.title: QR-code-assisted indoor localization for robots
candidates.shift: A two-stage multi-sensor fusion method using QR codes improves indoor positioning accuracy without expensive dedicated infrastructure.
candidates.ai_read: Tentative: legacy barcode tech re-emerging as cheap robotics infrastructure — could enable low-cost associate/robot navigation in stores and warehouses instead of UWB/BLE systems.
candidates.evidence: Research Square preprint describing a QR-assisted two-stage sensor fusion localization method.
candidates.initial_analysis: Shift from costly indoor positioning systems toward low-cost hybrid fusion using existing barcode infrastructure; if scaled, could cut cost of robot navigation in stores and warehouses.
candidates.author: Pan Zhang, Shuchang Xiao, Yixin Yang et al.
